title: Message passing and graph neural network layers
text: layer torch nn_module whose forward() calls message_passing(). one implements mean aggregator separate weights node neighbors: GraphSAGE update, graphlearnR also provides sage_conv().
code: my_conv <- nn_module(   initialize = function(in_features, out_features) {     self$lin_self <- nn_linear(in_features, out_features)     self$lin_nbr <- nn_linear(in_features, out_features, bias = FALSE)   },   forward = function(x, edge_index) {     agg <- message_passing(x, edge_index, aggr = "mean")     self$lin_self(x) + self$lin_nbr(agg)   } )  g <- dataset_karate() tt <- graph_tensors(g) torch_manual_seed(1) layer <- my_conv(34, 4) dim(layer(tt$x, tt$edge_index)) #> [1] 34  4

text: One layer heterogeneous graph transformer (HGT, Hu et al. 2020). target node \(t\) type \(\tau(t)\), incoming edge \(s\) relation \(r\), head \(h\) \(D\) channels, $$k_s = K_{\tau(s)} x_s,\ q_t = Q_{\tau(t)} x_t,\ v_s = V_{\tau(s)} x_s,$$ $$e_{st}^h = (k_s^h W^{att}_{r,h}) \cdot q_t^h \ \mu_{r,h} / \sqrt{D},$$ $$\alpha_{st}^h = \mathrm{softmax}_{s \N(t)}(e_{st}^h),$$ softmax runs incoming edges \(t\), across relations. update $$\tilde h_t = \sum_s \alpha_{st} (v_s W^{msg}_{r}),\quad   h_t' = \beta_{\tau(t)} A_{\tau(t)}(\mathrm{GELU}(\tilde h_t)) +   (1 - \beta_{\tau(t)}) x_t,$$ \(\beta = \mathrm{sigmoid}(\text{skip})\) learned gate per type (skip term used input output sizes match). Node types without incoming edges get \(A_{\tau}(0)\) plus skip term. Relative temporal encoding paper implemented.
